basics.name: Pietari Pennanen
basics.label: AI implementation / Editorial workflows / Learning materials
basics.summary:
I bring AI into real editorial work: I find where it fits, design and build the solution, and help people adopt it.

I'm a publishing editor at Otava Oppiminen, working on digital learning materials in mathematics and science. Since August 2026 my focus has been AI implementation in editorial work and content production, as part of Otava's AI team. I trained as a mathematics teacher.

work.name: University of Oulu
work.summary: Produced self-study materials for several courses in the research unit of mathematical sciences and shaped them into pedagogically sound Moodle material.

projects.name: Alt text that travels with every image
projects.description: Designed a pipeline for producing alt texts for images. An AI assistant generates the alt texts, an editor reviews them, and a lightweight tool writes them into the images' IPTC metadata. The descriptions are stored in each image, so they follow the image wherever it is used, and no image is left without an alt text.

projects.name: AI skills that know the house style
projects.description: Developed custom AI skills (Claude) that automate editorial and design tasks in learning-material production, such as branded presentations, vector math illustrations and data charts. Each skill builds in house style and quality rules, so the output is consistent and production-ready. I identified the needs with editorial staff, prototyped iteratively and prepared the skills for team-wide use.

projects.name: A translated maths book that still fits its pages
projects.description: Planned and piloted the translation of a digital mathematics book. Besides the text, the content had to fit back onto the product's pages, so I designed a workflow that combines text exports and imports with GitHub Copilot's agent for the translation itself.

projects.name: Tools that take the tedious parts off editors' plates
projects.description: Setting up one home for small internal tools, available behind company single sign-on. One tool combines the comments from several Word and PDF files into one document and anonymises them, and another helps plan product families more comprehensively. More tools are on the way. I also train colleagues to use AI in their own work.
